title: Balfour Declaration
detail: Britain declares support for a Jewish national home in Palestine, weeks before its army takes Jerusalem.

title: Nebi Musa riots
detail: Four days of violence in Jerusalem leave 5 Jews and 4 Arabs dead.

title: British Mandate begins
detail: The League of Nations Mandate for Palestine formally takes effect.

title: 1929 riots
detail: A week of violence kills 133 Jews and 116 Arabs, most of the Arabs shot by Mandate police.

title: Great Revolt begins
detail: A general strike becomes a three-year revolt against British rule; British forces kill thousands of Palestinians.

title: Peel Commission partition plan
detail: A British royal commission proposes partitioning Palestine for the first time.

title: 1939 White Paper
detail: Britain limits Jewish immigration as the revolt is crushed.

title: UN partition plan
detail: The UN General Assembly votes to partition Palestine; fighting breaks out the next day.

title: Deir Yassin massacre
detail: Irgun and Lehi fighters kill over 100 villagers near Jerusalem.

title: The Nakba
detail: Israel is declared as the Mandate ends; by 1949 about 750,000 Palestinians are expelled or flee and over 500 villages are depopulated.

title: Lydda and Ramle expulsions
detail: Tens of thousands are driven out of Lydda and Ramle after a massacre in Lydda.

title: Hula massacre
detail: Israeli soldiers kill dozens of villagers in Hula, southern Lebanon.

title: Armistice lines set
detail: The last armistice agreement fixes the lines that leave Gaza under Egypt and the West Bank under Jordan.

title: Qibya massacre
detail: An Israeli raid on the West Bank village of Qibya kills 69 people.

title: Kafr Qasim massacre
detail: Israeli Border Police kill 49 Palestinian citizens of Israel returning home under a curfew they had not been told of.

title: Gaza occupied; Khan Yunis massacre
detail: During the Suez war Israel occupies Gaza; UNRWA records 275 killed in Khan Yunis in one day.

title: Occupation of the West Bank and Gaza
detail: In six days Israel occupies the West Bank, East Jerusalem and Gaza; about 300,000 more Palestinians are displaced.

title: Land Day
detail: Six Palestinian citizens of Israel are killed protesting land confiscations.

title: Invasion of southern Lebanon
detail: Israel invades up to the Litani River, killing over a thousand Lebanese and Palestinians.

title: Invasion of Lebanon and siege of Beirut
detail: Israel invades Lebanon and besieges Beirut; Lebanese police count about 19,000 killed by the end of August.

title: Sabra and Shatila massacre
detail: Israeli-allied Phalange militia kill hundreds to thousands of Palestinian refugees and Lebanese in camps surrounded by the Israeli army.

title: Tunis air strike
detail: Israel bombs PLO headquarters near Tunis, killing between 41 and 71 people.

title: First Intifada
detail: A mass uprising begins in Gaza and spreads across the occupied territory.

title: Oslo Accords
detail: Israel and the PLO sign the first Oslo agreement, creating the Palestinian Authority.

title: Ibrahimi Mosque massacre
detail: A settler kills 29 Palestinians at prayer in Hebron.

title: Qana massacre
detail: Israeli shelling of a UN compound in Qana kills over 100 civilians sheltering there.

title: Withdrawal from southern Lebanon
detail: Israel ends its 22-year occupation of southern Lebanon.

title: Second Intifada
detail: A second uprising begins; over 4,800 Palestinians are killed by Israeli forces by the end of 2008.

title: Operation Defensive Shield
detail: Israel reinvades West Bank cities, including the siege of Jenin refugee camp.

title: Separation wall construction
detail: Israel begins building the wall; the ICJ rules it unlawful in 2004.

title: Gaza disengagement
detail: Israel withdraws settlers and troops from inside Gaza but keeps control of its borders, airspace and sea.

title: 2006 Lebanon war
detail: A 34-day Israeli assault on Lebanon kills about 1,190 people, most of them civilians.

title: Blockade of Gaza
detail: Israel and Egypt impose a land, sea and air blockade on Gaza.

title: Cast Lead
detail: A 22-day assault on Gaza kills about 1,400 Palestinians.

title: Pillar of Defense
detail: An eight-day assault on Gaza kills about 170 Palestinians.

title: Protective Edge
detail: A 51-day assault on Gaza kills over 2,250 Palestinians, including 551 children.

title: Great March of Return
detail: Weekly protests at Gaza's fence begin; by the end of 2018 Israeli forces have killed 180 people at the protests.

title: May 2021 war
detail: An 11-day assault on Gaza kills over 250 Palestinians amid uprisings across Palestine.

title: The current war
detail: After the Hamas-led attack, Israel begins the assault on Gaza tracked in detail on this site.
